rows.grounds: accusative object of absence expressed by binā; the animating principle
accusative subject of the implied state; the universe
compound expressing likeness: śava (corpse) + rūpa (form) + vat (like)

items.question: What condition renders the cosmic egg lifeless in the absence of power?
premises: Power is the animating principle of existence.
The cosmic egg depends on power for vitality.
Absence of power leaves only an inert form.
items.inference: Therefore, without power the cosmic egg is like a corpse.
uncertainties: The copula is implied rather than expressed in the verse.
items.plain_english: Without power, O great goddess, the universe is like a corpse.
